name: Town Cafe
tagline: Breakfast for less than nine dollars in Centerville.
about: Town Cafe in Centerville is a small-town cafe known for a big breakfast at a small price, featured by Family Destinations Guide for breakfast under $9.
Daily specials are posted on the cafe's Facebook page.
conflicts: Listings give two addresses (136 TX-75 and 132 S Commerce St) with the same phone number; hours vary, so the page leaves them off.
